approval_required_for: Implementation or enabling of the planned board current-layer causal-slice repair executor, if a future real trace makes a source or integration repair eligible.

Any change to architecture, pipeline structure, memory layout, numeric comparison policy, tolerance, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, semantic testbench, golden outputs, or required Transformer-block weight coverage.
Any replacement, simplification, or source-hash change to the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper or its discovered simulation sources.
Any lower-layer reopen without a current hash-bound boundary trace directly contradicting a named live lower-layer invariant or without an SACG-approved design-contract change.
Any guessed board target, Vivado cell, compile authority, simulator executable, or runtime ABI fact not established by current real tool evidence.

consumes: current Vivado export contexts and tool_profile authorization facts
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep board closure blocked. If the planned provenance capability is unavailable, record the multi-agent implementation gap and do not substitute a static script, guessed executable, simplified wrapper, stale diagnosis, or unchanged-source smoke replay.
executable_actions.rationale: The required exact_board_vcs_compile_provenance role is not present in action_grounding_registry. Use planned_tool.vcs_compile_diagnostic_source_provenance rather than inventing an unauthorized tool role. This is a verification identity/authority repair only: preserve the exact sample-project wrapper and simulation sources, and do not edit the DUT, kernel, monitor, golden artifacts, numeric policy, checkpoint, or stimulus.

consumes: current Vivado export contexts and authorized tool_profile facts
executable_actions.on_failure: If identity or authority binding still fails, return to repair_step.01. If the real tool launches and reports a semantic, liveness, order, AXI, DDR, or lifecycle symptom, preserve the output and execute repair_step.03; do not classify it as a lower-layer RTL failure.
executable_actions.rationale: The current earliest failed gate is case_axi_ddr_interface. Re-execute it only with a newly hash-bound identity document, canonical compile plan, exact Vivado authority references, and authorized executables. The current board-interface discovery pass may be reused; do not infer a new target or replace the sample-project wrapper.

executable_actions.on_failure: If no simulator terminal log or provenance is produced, return to repair_step.01 and classify it as verification-capability failure. If a real current-layer failure is produced, do not patch immediately; execute repair_step.04 before any source or integration repair.
executable_actions.rationale: After the interface gate passes, execute the real exact-wrapper VCS path rather than treating dependency-skipped artifacts as evidence. Keep the target checkpoint, deterministic input provenance, target-model expected outputs, numeric policy, semantic testbench hashes, complete Transformer-block weight manifest, and wrapper/source hashes immutable.

executable_actions.on_failure: Remain blocked and request a valid current-layer trace. Do not infer a root module from a downstream output symptom, do not patch the output module only, and do not create a lower-layer backtrack request without an explicit current trace contradiction.
executable_actions.rationale: This conditional step is mandatory before any current-layer code repair when repair_step.03 produces a real board-wrapped failure. Localize the earliest violated board boundary or transaction using the case-adapter trace schema. Distinguish independent AXI/prefetch progress from core start, ingress, egress, output, and lifecycle-frontier progress. Do not reopen leaf or connected-kernel layers unless the resulting trace directly contradicts a named hash-validated lower-layer invariant.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote and do not retry with a broader patch. Preserve the failure slice, keep all current contamination barriers active, and return to repair_step.02 for the same board layer only after an approved bounded repair artifact exists.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after repair_step.04 identifies an earliest causal violation may a bounded repair be attempted. The required board current-layer causal-slice repair executor is not present in the registry, so planned_tool.board_current_layer_causal_slice_repair records the implementation gap. Any repair must be limited to the trace-identified loader, harness, instrumentation, generated integration, or board-runtime contract; it must preserve the exact sample-project wrapper/source hashes and certified lower-layer kernel artifacts.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the board layer at needs_repair. Route any real value, order, liveness, AXI, DDR, or frontier failure to repair_step.04; classify a missing checker or golden/reference capability as verification-capability repair rather than hardware correctness. Do not proceed to backend synthesis or runtime.
executable_actions.rationale: After the interface gate and real VCS evidence pass, or after an approved trace-localized repair has been applied and revalidated, rerun the remaining board-layer case tools in dependency order. Re-execute the board pipeline gate if its identity-sensitive inputs changed; do not use smoke or dependency-skipped evidence for promotion.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep board closure blocked. Missing target-model, tolerance, semantic-testbench, complete tensor, or executed weight-consumption evidence is a checker/golden-reference repair, not evidence of hardware correctness. A real DUT mismatch or liveness failure must return to repair_step.04; never derive expected outputs or tolerances from RTL output.
executable_actions.rationale: The missing board_axi_ddr semantic report must be generated only from executed real board evidence and the immutable independent target-model contract. It must prove complete Transformer-block weight coverage and loader consumption, same-input/checkpoint reference comparison, resolved numeric policy, data order, transfer counts, address mapping, liveness, and lifecycle/output-frontier evidence. It must exclude embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work from the DUT golden and weight-coverage boundary.

executable_actions.on_failure: Retain needs_repair status and active contamination barriers, issue or maintain the Stage7 retry request, and do not promote to synthesis, implementation, bitstream generation, runtime ABI, or board runtime. Any new failure must re-enter the same board-layer tool-output to CCTG/localization to bounded-repair loop.
executable_actions.rationale: Return the repaired evidence set to Stage7 and evaluate the complete board_axi_ddr_closure gate DAG plus SACG trust and retry barriers. Promotion is permitted only if every required real-tool and semantic checker passes with current hashes. The six scoped open retry requests remain downstream-consumption blockers until this refined Stage7 result is promoted.

observations: The earliest current-layer executed failure is real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface. Its report rejects the simulation manifest because source_identity_sha256 does not bind the current identity document, compile authority and ordered-command authority references do not bind exact Vivado export facts, and the simulator executables are not authorized by the current tool profile or cited export.

The prior VCS diagnosis is explicitly historical_only and not executable because its layer/gate/source binding is stale. It must not be used as a hardware root cause or as authorization for RTL replacement. The required next evidence is preserved VCS compile provenance, including the first real error, compile status/return code/failure class, remote state, terminal-log status and tail, hierarchy-report validator context, canonical source set, exact wrapper hashes, Vivado export facts, executable authorization, and remote cleanup provenance.

case_vcs_functional_sim, case_vcs_evidence_analyzer, case_deadlock_axi_check, and all later board gates are not_run or dependency-skipped. The current functional_sim=fail result is therefore an aggregate dependency failure; there is no current board-level value, numeric, order, AXI, DDR, liveness, complete-weight-consumption, lifecycle-frontier, or output evidence.

The live hierarchical certificates prove operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer closure. No current hash-bound boundary trace contradicts a named lower-layer invariant, so those layers remain reusable and must not be reopened. The connected kernel's certified semantics are elastic variable-latency token-pipeline semantics with preserved boundary order and cross-token overlap; same-cycle start/end across unequal-latency stages is not a requirement.

The current boundary_trace.json being reported as ready is associated with skipped functional simulation and is not current executed hardware evidence. After the provenance repair enables a real simulation, any real liveness, value, order, protocol, or frontier failure must first go through current-layer boundary tracing and targeted replay before a code repair is considered.

At board scope, independent AXI or prefetch progress cannot be treated as output or lifecycle-frontier progress. A frontier stall is only localization evidence; it does not identify an RTL root cause or establish a pass.

sacg_memory_truth is authoritative for this scope: six open retry requests require a repaired Stage7 verification rerun, zero scoped open backtrack requests exist, and active contamination barriers prevent rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts from being consumed as validated design inputs. Older failure labels in persisted history do not add independent current blockers beyond this truth set.

Any semantic rerun must use the same immutable target checkpoint and stimulus, expected outputs generated by real target-model inference, resolved immutable numeric policy, generated semantic-testbench hashes, complete-scope Transformer-block tensor catalog, and executed proof that every required bound weight was consumed. Files merely existing on disk are insufficient.

The conditional design-team router returned no_split; it supplies no replacement for checker or real-tool evidence. No board pass, backend promotion, bitstream release, runtime-ABI release, or board-runtime claim is authorized.
proposed_actions: Implement or enable the missing exact-board VCS compile-provenance capability and produce hash-bound identity/authority diagnostics without changing the exact wrapper or certified design artifacts.
Rerun case_axi_ddr_interface only after the provenance package passes static identity, authority, hash, and contract checks.

If the rerun permits execution, run the real board VCS functional path and its analyzer/deadlock evidence; if it produces a real failure, run current-layer boundary trace and targeted replay before any code repair.
Apply no lower-layer backtrack unless a current hash-bound trace explicitly contradicts a named leaf or connected-kernel invariant.

After current-layer real-tool evidence is clean, rerun the remaining board gate DAG, assemble complete board semantic evidence, and rerun Stage7 final artifact/trust/retry checks before any promotion.
risks: Repairing the wrapper, replacing the sample-project source set, guessing a top module or compute cell, or authorizing an unbound simulator would bypass exact board identity and human-boundary constraints.
A source-level repair before a real current-layer trace would conflate a verification environment failure with an RTL semantic failure and could contaminate certified lower-layer evidence.
A missing board semantic-evidence report can hide incomplete weight binding, wrong data order, numeric mismatch, or tail-model work being incorrectly included in the DUT boundary.
A board output-frontier symptom without direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal boundary, and current hash-bound certificate cannot justify reopening the connected kernel.
Changing checkpoint, stimulus, tolerance, numeric comparison policy, semantic testbench, golden outputs, or wrapper source hashes during repair would invalidate all prior evidence.
Downstream not_run gates are evidence gaps rather than independent failures, but attempting promotion before their case-tool protocols pass would violate the hierarchical repair loop.

The current source and tool evidence does not establish a causal board RTL module; any current-layer repair must be limited to the trace-localized loader, harness, instrumentation, or integration slice and must preserve the exact wrapper source identity.

constraints: exact sample-project wrapper and source-hash identity must remain immutable
checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, tolerance, and semantic testbench hashes remain immutable
Transformer blocks are the complete DUT scope; embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling remain outside acceptance boundaries
edges: case_axi_ddr_interface -> case_vcs_functional_sim -> functional_sim -> board current-layer gates
case_vcs_functional_sim failure -> boundary_trace_rerun -> failure_slice_localization -> bounded current-layer repair
current-layer trace with explicit lower invariant contradiction -> targeted lower-layer revalidation

Do not patch certified leaf or connected-kernel RTL, do not alter the exact wrapper, checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, semantic testbench, or golden artifacts, and do not promote to backend or board runtime. The current functional_sim failure is dependency-blocked aggregate evidence, not a localized hardware failure.
